_comment: Hand-written. Story names and lines for existing bosses (design/story/boss-roles.md, design/npcs/*-dialogue.md). Read by server_scripts/tt_boss_lore.js. name: boss-bar name (set as the boss's custom name); short: the name shown everywhere else (entity name via lang override: death messages, Jade, quest kill tasks), defaults to name; warden-like bosses with no lines just get the name; color: a KubeJS Text colour; intro: said once when the boss first appears; phases: said once when its health drops below 'at' (fraction); death: said when it falls. Lines go to players within 96 blocks.

mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.name: The Armoury Warden
mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.intro: &7The sealed armoury's guardian wakes. Its axe remembers the Thornwatch.

mowziesmobs:umvuthi.name: Your Hollow Self
mowziesmobs:umvuthi.intro: &8It wears your stance. It fights with your hands.
mowziesmobs:umvuthi.death: &8The Hollow face cracks. What's left of it looks almost relieved.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.name: The Night Lich, Hollow General
bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.intro: &3A crown of bone. A voice like a tomb. The siege has a commander.

cataclysm:ignis.name: Ignis, the Burning King
cataclysm:ignis.intro: &6The Burning King rises from his throne of slag.

mowziesmobs:frostmaw.name: Frostmaw
mowziesmobs:frostmaw.intro: &bBig. White. Tusks like &othis&r&b. Wren drew it smaller than it is.

cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.name: The Choir War-Engine
cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.intro: &4The Stranger: &o"Do try to survive it. I've grown fond of you."
cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.death: &4The war-engine collapses. Something in its chest is still humming. Pell will want that.

cataclysm:the_harbinger.name: The Choir Herald

phases.line: &cThe Herald's song changes key. Its rail core is charging.

cataclysm:the_harbinger.death: &cThe song stops. Its rail core is intact.

cataclysm:the_leviathan.name: The Leviathan of the Sunken City
cataclysm:the_leviathan.intro: &1The Choir woke it. It is not sleeping anymore.

cataclysm:ender_guardian.name: Crucible Trial I: The Ender Guardian
cataclysm:ender_guardian.intro: &dIlsabet: &o"Each tier opens the next. Try not to be unworthy."

cataclysm:maledictus.name: Crucible Trial II: Maledictus
cataclysm:maledictus.intro: &2The second trial. It was made to be unbeatable by anyone unworthy.

cataclysm:ancient_remnant.name: Crucible Trial III: The Ancient Remnant
cataclysm:ancient_remnant.intro: &eThe last trial. The last Shard is in its keeping.

minecraft:ender_dragon.name: Malric's Bound Beast
minecraft:ender_dragon.intro: &5Malric: &o"Shard-Born. Little splinter of my Crown. Did you think you found them? They found you, for me."
minecraft:ender_dragon.death: &5Malric: &o"You cut the leash. It doesn't matter. I don't need the beast. I need you to finish what Ysolde started."

cataclysm:scylla.name: Malric, the Hollow Regent
cataclysm:scylla.intro: &5Malric: &o"So. You finally came home to me."

phases.line: &5Malric: &o"Look at your world. Ash, Hollowed, cults in stolen armour. One will, one Crown, and all of it ends."
&5Malric: &o"You were made from the Crown. You are order. Stop fighting what you are."

cataclysm:scylla.death: &5Malric: &o"Then choose. You'll find it's harder than killing me."

minecraft:wither.name: Echo of the Sundering
minecraft:wither.intro: &8The Crown is gone, but the Sundering still echoes. Something answers it.

twilightforest:naga.name: The Coiled Serpent, First Warden
twilightforest:naga.intro: &2The Coiled Serpent hisses. &7The first warden of the dusk-forest wakes.
twilightforest:naga.death: &2The serpent goes still. &7Somewhere deeper in the forest, the second warden stirs.

twilightforest:lich.name: The Dusk Lich, Second Warden
twilightforest:lich.intro: &6The Dusk Lich: &o"Another Shard-Born. The Regent sends his regards."
twilightforest:lich.death: &6The Dusk Lich: &o"The Hydra... will not be... so polite."

twilightforest:hydra.name: The Mire Hydra, Third Warden
twilightforest:hydra.intro: &4Three heads rise out of the fire swamp. &7The third warden will not let you pass.
twilightforest:hydra.death: &4The Mire Hydra collapses into the swamp. &7Its trophies are yours.

twilightforest:ur_ghast.name: The Weeping Ghast, Keeper of the Twilight Shard
twilightforest:ur_ghast.intro: &cThe Weeping Ghast howls. &7It has guarded the Twilight Shard so long it forgot why.
twilightforest:ur_ghast.death: &cThe weeping stops. &7The Twilight Shard is free.

aether:slider.name: The Trial Stone
aether:slider.intro: &7The stone grinds awake. &oThe Valkyries' first trial has begun.
aether:slider.death: &7The Trial Stone cracks apart. The Valkyries are watching.

aether:valkyrie_queen.name: The Valkyrie Queen, Judge of the Trial
aether:valkyrie_queen.death: &eThe Valkyrie Queen: &o"You fell well. The Sun Spirit will not be so kind."

aether:sun_spirit.name: The Sun Spirit, Keeper of the Aether Shard
aether:sun_spirit.death: &6The Sun Spirit's fire gutters out. &7The Aether Shard lies in the ashes.

undergarden:forgotten_guardian.name: The Forgotten Guardian, Keeper of the Undergarden Shard
undergarden:forgotten_guardian.intro: &3The Forgotten Guardian stirs. &7It still remembers its last order: let no one take the Shard.
undergarden:forgotten_guardian.death: &3The Guardian falls silent at last. &7The Undergarden Shard is yours.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith.name: Old Engine Sentry: Obsidilith
bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith.intro: &5The Old Engine sentry hums awake. &7Choir sigils glow along its sides.
bosses_of_mass_destruction:obsidilith.death: &5The sentry's hum dies. &7One Choir stronghold is open.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet.name: Old Engine Sentry: The Gauntlet
bosses_of_mass_destruction:gauntlet.intro: &8The Gauntlet's eye opens. &7The Choir rewired it to hunt Shard-Born.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_blossom.name: Crucible Affix: The Void Blossom
bosses_of_mass_destruction:void_blossom.intro: &dThe Crucible blooms. &7Something hungry grows out of the Void.
